name: boss_grows_and_is_not_a_cut
why: ENTRY Z-C21.2, finding M7. An extrusion made on a FACE has type «ICE» (IFeature.GetTypeName2), and edit_extrusion took every «ICE» for a cut. IFeature~GetTypeName2.html: «To get the underlying type of feature of an Instant3D feature (i.e., "ICE"), call IFeature::GetTypeName». Whether it is a cut or a boss is told by the definition: IExtrudeFeatureData2~IsBossFeature.html, «True if this extrusion is a boss feature». A boss made by extrude_on_face became «cut» in the answer, and «through_all» on a boss was not refused.
defect_caught: Two. Step 3 takes the stud from 20 to 30: the answer must say «extrusion» (on the old library it says «cut») and the volume must grow by pi*10^2*10. Step 4 asks for «through_all» on the stud: it must refuse, as for any extrusion (on the old library it passed the check, because «ICE» counted as «cut»).
_and_the_twin_is_in_the_same_file: The refusal (step 4) and step 3 change the same feature and differ by one argument: «through_all» instead of «depth_mm».

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: 96000 plus pi x 10^2 x 20

expect.why: IsBossFeature: the stud is a boss. On the old library this said «cut»

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: 96000 plus pi x 10^2 x 30
